positive_scenarios: First valid original fact; actual source/receipt/Storage identities join.
Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.
Restart at each source/pending/append/first-receipt/terminal boundary converges without redispatch.
Read genuine retained original after live state, permission generation, route or current format recipe changed; current visibility still independently enforced.
Current, zero-match nonempty, proven empty, degraded, compaction/rebuild and inclusive restart coverage.
Large source/result/payload uses SP-337, entire wrapper bound holds.
Original historical integer/float/timestamp recipe is authenticated; current shared profile never reinterprets it.
Coherent original backup/restore, with derived state rebuilt and no live authority restored.
Separate accepted created/updated/removed original-result cases, preserving last fenced generation for removed and no fabricated after object.
families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Read the original destination mutation receipt and exact before/after destination generations. Verify owning_server_id equals writer server_id; the prior ref is null only for evidenced absence. Source locator/profile/repository IDs are refs, never bucket credentials, absolute paths or Recovery Keys. Save once after destination CAS/readback; unchanged or failed acceptance emits nothing. Destination removal cannot imply deletion of repository snapshots or reset independent repository authority.
phase_2_gates: Rebase on reviewed NUMRULE and GUARDTOOL foundation supplied by lead.
Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Select current BackupRun v2 and its immutable phase-journal entry. Enforce the BRS-005 phase order and actual restart-convergence receipt. completed requires complete capture, every destination committed and non-null manifest; partial/failed/cancelled preserve their failure evidence. Capture, destination upload, integrity level and restore test remain independent. Retrying a phase reuses its original journal entry; a genuinely new phase has its own accepted entry. Project Backup has its one actual Project; Full Server Backup is application scope even when it includes Projects. No synthetic runtime run_id is created.
phase_2_gates: Rebase on reviewed NUMRULE and GUARDTOOL foundation supplied by lead.
Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

scope_partition_boundary.positive: At each complete stored-value site and its registry mirror, accept app and the exact encoded Project partition for valid original IDs up to the owner maximum; no separate character cap narrows encoder output. SP-340 still measures the entire encoded stored value at 16 KiB after SP-337 routing.
scope_partition_boundary.negative: Start from each complete valid value. Separately replace only scope_partition with the raw Project ID, project~ with no suffix, a suffix of length 1 modulo 4, a padded suffix, a non-base64url character, or nonzero unused final bits; each fails the partition grammar. A same-shape different valid partition targets only the exact original/key/value scope join, with unrelated hashes/copies repaired. Invalid UTF-8 or a canonical suffix not encoding the actual owner Project targets the encoder/source join. No overlength-partition negative is invented: source ID and full encoded-value limits are separate guards.
scope_partition_boundary.isolation: Lexical schema cases run before semantic joins; for integrated cases keep every non-target copy/key/digest coherent and cut only the selected predicate in phase 2. Inventory the pattern and no-control-character sites separately, including the trailing-LF case; do not label distinct predicates as duplicates or claim phase-1 isolation.
scope_partition_boundary.source_and_storage_boundaries: Separate source-ID boundary: a 256-character owner-valid ASCII Project ID passes; append one allowed character (257) and coherently regenerate its partition/keys/copies/digests so only the owner/payload Project-ID bound is invalid. Separate SP-340 boundary: a fully valid entire stored wrapper/part at 16384 encoded bytes passes; one additional encoded byte (16385) refuses or requires SP-337 routing, with all references and resolved-body joins valid. No new partition character cap substitutes for either bound.

original_reference_boundaries.positive: Use complete valid original records and matching complete payloads at 1, 256, 257, 300, 511 and 512 characters, using lexical owner-valid references. Preserve exact nullability per imported field.
original_reference_boundaries.negative: For each field separately, derive from its complete 512-character positive and append one allowed character (513): only maxLength fails. From the one-character positive use an empty string: record the implied minLength/pattern sites truthfully under the shared inventory without claiming independently removable guards. Separately use a same-length prohibited reference (absolute/file/secret-bearing locator), or a wrong exact type; for non-nullable journal_ref add null. Keep other fields and non-target original/payload/custody copies, keys and digests coherent; lexical boundary probes run before the source equality join.
original_reference_boundaries.reference_closure: Eagerly resolve the exact imported original field and its nested non_secret_ref/nullable_non_secret_ref; inventory their predicate sites with the shared tool in phase 2. Include a one-defect exact-reference join mismatch using a different otherwise-valid locator.
original_reference_boundaries.isolation: Cut each length/lexical/type/nullability/join predicate independently; only same-field identical predicates at multiple sites qualify as duplicates. Every invalid case has one defect and zero new effects.

families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

original_reference_boundaries.positive: Use complete valid original records and matching complete payloads at 1, 256, 257, 300, 511 and 512 characters, using lexical owner-valid references. Preserve exact nullability per imported field.
original_reference_boundaries.negative: For each field separately, derive from its complete 512-character positive and append one allowed character (513): only maxLength fails. From the one-character positive use an empty string: record the implied minLength/pattern sites truthfully under the shared inventory without claiming independently removable guards. Separately use a same-length prohibited reference (absolute/file/secret-bearing locator), or a wrong exact type; for non-nullable journal_ref add null. Keep other fields and non-target original/payload/custody copies, keys and digests coherent; lexical boundary probes run before the source equality join.
original_reference_boundaries.reference_closure: Eagerly resolve the exact imported original field and its nested non_secret_ref/nullable_non_secret_ref; inventory their predicate sites with the shared tool in phase 2. Include a one-defect exact-reference join mismatch using a different otherwise-valid locator.
original_reference_boundaries.isolation: Cut each length/lexical/type/nullability/join predicate independently; only same-field identical predicates at multiple sites qualify as duplicates. Every invalid case has one defect and zero new effects.

schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.
Restart at each source/pending/append/first-receipt/terminal boundary converges without redispatch.
Read genuine retained original after live state, permission generation, route or current format recipe changed; current visibility still independently enforced.
Current, zero-match nonempty, proven empty, degraded, compaction/rebuild and inclusive restart coverage.
Large source/result/payload uses SP-337, entire wrapper bound holds.
Original historical integer/float/timestamp recipe is authenticated; current shared profile never reinterprets it.
Coherent original backup/restore, with derived state rebuilt and no live authority restored.

Original remote_route_migration_record.journal_ref: preserve the exact non-secret reference at 300 and 512 characters through payload (inline and SP-337-resolved), append, retry and retained read, including null only where the original owner permits it; no truncation or replacement locator.
families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Use remote_route_migration_record and its phase journal, preserving same-Server source/target endpoint/fingerprint, all expected/observed generations and currentness joins. Follow planned/preflight/stage/identity/transport checks before preference switch, drain and post-switch completion; a failed verification takes the existing rollback/blocked/recovery route. complete requires durable same-Server identity and currentness fences plus preserved command idempotency/cursor, switched preference and drained old route. Re-observation is not another migration.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

original_reference_boundaries.positive: Use complete valid original records and matching complete payloads at 1, 256, 257, 300, 511 and 512 characters, using lexical owner-valid references. Preserve exact nullability per imported field.
original_reference_boundaries.negative: For each field separately, derive from its complete 512-character positive and append one allowed character (513): only maxLength fails. From the one-character positive use an empty string: record the implied minLength/pattern sites truthfully under the shared inventory without claiming independently removable guards. Separately use a same-length prohibited reference (absolute/file/secret-bearing locator), or a wrong exact type; for non-nullable journal_ref add null. Keep other fields and non-target original/payload/custody copies, keys and digests coherent; lexical boundary probes run before the source equality join.
original_reference_boundaries.reference_closure: Eagerly resolve the exact imported original field and its nested non_secret_ref/nullable_non_secret_ref; inventory their predicate sites with the shared tool in phase 2. Include a one-defect exact-reference join mismatch using a different otherwise-valid locator.
original_reference_boundaries.isolation: Cut each length/lexical/type/nullability/join predicate independently; only same-field identical predicates at multiple sites qualify as duplicates. Every invalid case has one defect and zero new effects.

schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.

schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.

positive_scenarios: First valid original fact; actual source/receipt/Storage identities join.
Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.
Restart at each source/pending/append/first-receipt/terminal boundary converges without redispatch.
Read genuine retained original after live state, permission generation, route or current format recipe changed; current visibility still independently enforced.
Current, zero-match nonempty, proven empty, degraded, compaction/rebuild and inclusive restart coverage.
Large source/result/payload uses SP-337, entire wrapper bound holds.
Original historical integer/float/timestamp recipe is authenticated; current shared profile never reinterprets it.
Coherent original backup/restore, with derived state rebuilt and no live authority restored.
families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Join the exact route and endpoint to verified Server identity. ready/active need current route tests and pairing/auth; public routes also need their exact current policy/preflight/explicit consent, hosted-only Funnel and no prohibited surfaces. disabled preserves private routes, identity and running work as RAS-004 requires. An unknown transport outcome remains degraded/blocked/recovery_required under the actual owner result and never becomes successful by absence of a failure.

families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Resolve the original RemoteAccessTestReceipt for the actual test invocation and exact Server/endpoint/route generations. passed requires identity verified, fingerprints equal, compatible protocol, API/WebSocket/stream/file checks passed, no failure refs and applicable public-security checks passed. failed/blocked/cancelled preserve non-success and the original failure evidence; a failure oracle must reject a substituted success exit/status. A retry of terminal-result delivery neither reruns the network test nor alters its outcome.
phase_2_gates: Rebase on reviewed NUMRULE and GUARDTOOL foundation supplied by lead.
Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

families.source_snapshot_plan: Resolve source_evidence_ref as this family schema #/$defs/owner_fact, validate existing before/after record schema, authenticate original_result_ref and every actual authority join independently. No matching digest or all-true fixture can stand in for owner issuance. Fixed role roster: writer_fence, permission_or_service_authority, test_invocation, test_receipt, identity_material, public_security_result. Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.
Restart at each source/pending/append/first-receipt/terminal boundary converges without redispatch.

Large source/result/payload uses SP-337, entire wrapper bound holds.
Original historical integer/float/timestamp recipe is authenticated; current shared profile never reinterprets it.
Coherent original backup/restore, with derived state rebuilt and no live authority restored.
Project: first append, same-original retry and lost acknowledgement, retained history read, custody recovery and checkpoint advance/restart; exact key/value/envelope/original-scope joins throughout.

Full Server/application: first append, same-original retry and lost acknowledgement, retained history read, custody recovery and checkpoint advance/restart; exact key/value/envelope/original-scope joins throughout.

Project boundary: owner-valid project: plus 248 ASCII a characters (256 characters total), encoded by the existing UTF-8/base64url-no-pad encoder to a 350-character project~ partition; append/retry/custody/history/checkpoint all accept it. Also cover owner-valid Project IDs at 254 and 255 characters for all final base64 quantum branches; application uses exactly app and project_id=null.

Original restore_run.preview_receipt_ref: preserve the exact non-secret reference at 300 and 512 characters through payload (inline and SP-337-resolved), append, retry and retained read, including null only where the original owner permits it; no truncation or replacement locator.
families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Resolve current RestoreRun v2 and the exact original phase entry. Apply manifest/compatibility/preview/approval, BRS-023 recovery point or narrowly validated emergency consent, quarantined staging, staged verification, identity/credential/source resolution and quiesce before activation; rebuild and post-verify before complete. Atomic activation or its owned journal governs uncertain outcome. as_new rewrites internal identities and grants no external forge/trust authority; server_full is application scope. Restore never revives sessions, credentials, public routes, Goals or schedules. Full restore keeps those paused and separately revalidated. Rollback is offered only with a real recovery point.

Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

scope_partition_boundary.positive: At each complete stored-value site and its registry mirror, accept app and the exact encoded Project partition for valid original IDs up to the owner maximum; no separate character cap narrows encoder output. SP-340 still measures the entire encoded stored value at 16 KiB after SP-337 routing.
scope_partition_boundary.negative: Start from each complete valid value. Separately replace only scope_partition with the raw Project ID, project~ with no suffix, a suffix of length 1 modulo 4, a padded suffix, a non-base64url character, or nonzero unused final bits; each fails the partition grammar. A same-shape different valid partition targets only the exact original/key/value scope join, with unrelated hashes/copies repaired. Invalid UTF-8 or a canonical suffix not encoding the actual owner Project targets the encoder/source join. No overlength-partition negative is invented: source ID and full encoded-value limits are separate guards.
scope_partition_boundary.isolation: Lexical schema cases run before semantic joins; for integrated cases keep every non-target copy/key/digest coherent and cut only the selected predicate in phase 2. Inventory the pattern and no-control-character sites separately, including the trailing-LF case; do not label distinct predicates as duplicates or claim phase-1 isolation.
scope_partition_boundary.source_and_storage_boundaries: Separate source-ID boundary: a 256-character owner-valid ASCII Project ID passes; append one allowed character (257) and coherently regenerate its partition/keys/copies/digests so only the owner/payload Project-ID bound is invalid. Separate SP-340 boundary: a fully valid entire stored wrapper/part at 16384 encoded bytes passes; one additional encoded byte (16385) refuses or requires SP-337 routing, with all references and resolved-body joins valid. No new partition character cap substitutes for either bound.

original_reference_boundaries.positive: Use complete valid original records and matching complete payloads at 1, 256, 257, 300, 511 and 512 characters, using lexical owner-valid references. Preserve exact nullability per imported field.
original_reference_boundaries.negative: For each field separately, derive from its complete 512-character positive and append one allowed character (513): only maxLength fails. From the one-character positive use an empty string: record the implied minLength/pattern sites truthfully under the shared inventory without claiming independently removable guards. Separately use a same-length prohibited reference (absolute/file/secret-bearing locator), or a wrong exact type; for non-nullable journal_ref add null. Keep other fields and non-target original/payload/custody copies, keys and digests coherent; lexical boundary probes run before the source equality join.
original_reference_boundaries.reference_closure: Eagerly resolve the exact imported original field and its nested non_secret_ref/nullable_non_secret_ref; inventory their predicate sites with the shared tool in phase 2. Include a one-defect exact-reference join mismatch using a different otherwise-valid locator.
original_reference_boundaries.isolation: Cut each length/lexical/type/nullability/join predicate independently; only same-field identical predicates at multiple sites qualify as duplicates. Every invalid case has one defect and zero new effects.

families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Follow created/waiting identity/waiting approval/issuing trust/complete with owner-authorized reject, requester cancel, expiry, blocked or failed endings. complete requires exact current candidate/Server fingerprints, explicit identity match/approval actor and original trust issuance receipt; entering waiting or checking for a request grants nothing. Raw QR/code/setup material and process-local handles never enter history. An answered request stays answered; a fresh request has a new generation. Rejecting a later request preserves trust granted earlier.

Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.

families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Consume cmd.client.revoke original receipt and RevocationRecord. effective_trust_generation must equal previous_trust_generation plus one and the current trust record must be revoked. Independently enumerate all active sessions at the revocation fence, terminate every one and reject future sessions/stale commands before terminal publication. The caller cannot supply a conveniently incomplete session set. Session-only revoke, rename and Catalog removal are not this fact. Re-delivery returns the immutable original result.
phase_2_gates: Rebase on reviewed NUMRULE and GUARDTOOL foundation supplied by lead.
Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

families.source_snapshot_plan: Resolve source_evidence_ref as this family schema #/$defs/owner_fact, validate existing before/after record schema, authenticate original_result_ref and every actual authority join independently. Fixed role roster: writer_fence, permission_or_service_authority, revocation_receipt, trust_before, trust_after, complete_active_session_set, session_termination_set. positive_scenarios: First valid original fact; actual source/receipt/Storage identities join.
Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.
Restart at each source/pending/append/first-receipt/terminal boundary converges without redispatch.
Read genuine retained original after live state, permission generation, route or current format recipe changed; current visibility still independently enforced.
Current, zero-match nonempty, proven empty, degraded, compaction/rebuild and inclusive restart coverage.
Large source/result/payload uses SP-337, entire wrapper bound holds.
Original historical integer/float/timestamp recipe is authenticated; current shared profile never reinterprets it.
Coherent original backup/restore, with derived state rebuilt and no live authority restored.
families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Validate the exact Client/Server/access policy and original protected grant/update/expiry/revocation outcome, including expected trust/policy/session generations and current permission. Active trust requires the actual pairing/grant proof; reachability, discovery, tailnet membership or a view marker cannot create it. A revocation may also have its separately defined server.client_revoked fact, with distinct original fact identities; neither substitutes for the other. Server-peer settings trust grants no Client/content/work authority and is not accepted here.
phase_2_gates: Rebase on reviewed NUMRULE and GUARDTOOL foundation supplied by lead.
Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

families.source_snapshot_plan: Resolve source_evidence_ref as this family schema #/$defs/owner_fact, validate existing before/after record schema, authenticate original_result_ref and every actual authority join independently. Fixed role roster: writer_fence, permission_or_service_authority, protected_grant_or_mutation, client_access_policy, client_session_fence. positive_scenarios: First valid original fact; actual source/receipt/Storage identities join.
Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.
Restart at each source/pending/append/first-receipt/terminal boundary converges without redispatch.
Read genuine retained original after live state, permission generation, route or current format recipe changed; current visibility still independently enforced.
Current, zero-match nonempty, proven empty, degraded, compaction/rebuild and inclusive restart coverage.
Large source/result/payload uses SP-337, entire wrapper bound holds.
Original historical integer/float/timestamp recipe is authenticated; current shared profile never reinterprets it.
Coherent original backup/restore, with derived state rebuilt and no live authority restored.
families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Bind the actual Client/Server/endpoint and connection attempt to ServerConnectionProjection. current requires real session and trust generation and a verified cursor or snapshot catch-up. reconnect/resume reuse cmd.server.connect, prior session and resume cursor without new work. Cached/offline is never current success; mismatch is blocked, not another Server. Client close/sleep/refresh changes connectivity only and cannot cancel Server-owned work or authorize failover.
phase_2_gates: Rebase on reviewed NUMRULE and GUARDTOOL foundation supplied by lead.
Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

families.source_snapshot_plan: Resolve source_evidence_ref as this family schema #/$defs/owner_fact, validate existing before/after record schema, authenticate original_result_ref and every actual authority join independently. No matching digest or all-true fixture can stand in for owner issuance. Fixed role roster: writer_fence, permission_or_service_authority, connection_attempt, session_authority, trust_authority, catchup_cursor_or_snapshot. Null roles require actual source-phase inapplicability; the caller never chooses required slots.

positive_scenarios: First valid original fact; actual source/receipt/Storage identities join.
Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.
Restart at each source/pending/append/first-receipt/terminal boundary converges without redispatch.
Read genuine retained original after live state, permission generation, route or current format recipe changed; current visibility still independently enforced.
Current, zero-match nonempty, proven empty, degraded, compaction/rebuild and inclusive restart coverage.
Large source/result/payload uses SP-337, entire wrapper bound holds.
Original historical integer/float/timestamp recipe is authenticated; current shared profile never reinterprets it.
Coherent original backup/restore, with derived state rebuilt and no live authority restored.
families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Resolve the exact original DiscoveryObservation and its expires_at_utc. The discovery owner compares its admitted clock observation to that expiry and durably records the expiry decision once. Expiring one source does not expire a newer observation or another source and never revokes pairing/trust. Replay reads the recorded expiry decision; it must not compare old history to the present clock or mint expiry again.
phase_2_gates: Rebase on reviewed NUMRULE and GUARDTOOL foundation supplied by lead.
Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

positive_scenarios: First valid original fact; actual source/receipt/Storage identities join.
Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.
Restart at each source/pending/append/first-receipt/terminal boundary converges without redispatch.
Read genuine retained original after live state, permission generation, route or current format recipe changed; current visibility still independently enforced.
Current, zero-match nonempty, proven empty, degraded, compaction/rebuild and inclusive restart coverage.
Large source/result/payload uses SP-337, entire wrapper bound holds.
Original historical integer/float/timestamp recipe is authenticated; current shared profile never reinterprets it.
Coherent original backup/restore, with derived state rebuilt and no live authority restored.
families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: DiscoveryObservation supplies minimal fingerprint/human name/TLS port/protocol/capability/claim summary, source and expiry. The observation fingerprint is not a verified observed Server ID. server_id in this event names the actual writing Server, not an unclaimed discovered computer; no synthetic Server is claimed to save discovery. A Client-only read-only discovery draft before durable Server custody remains an ordinary live observation, not a new event writer. No subnet scan, Projects, paths, users, provider/settings/app-work metadata or secrets are advertised or saved in the event. Discovery grants no trust or deduplication.
phase_2_gates: Rebase on reviewed NUMRULE and GUARDTOOL foundation supplied by lead.
Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal. Phase 2 must resolve logically implied schema-site guards truthfully with the shared predicate inventory; no phase-1 proof is claimed.

families.source_snapshot_plan: Resolve source_evidence_ref as this family schema #/$defs/owner_fact, validate existing before/after record schema, authenticate original_result_ref and every actual authority join independently. No matching digest or all-true fixture can stand in for owner issuance. Fixed role roster: writer_fence, permission_or_service_authority, bounded_discovery_source, original_observation, expiry_assignment. positive_scenarios: First valid original fact; actual source/receipt/Storage identities join.
Same original retry and lost acknowledgement return the same immutable result, with one event.
Restart at each source/pending/append/first-receipt/terminal boundary converges without redispatch.

Current, zero-match nonempty, proven empty, degraded, compaction/rebuild and inclusive restart coverage.
Large source/result/payload uses SP-337, entire wrapper bound holds.
Original historical integer/float/timestamp recipe is authenticated; current shared profile never reinterprets it.

families.format_number_plan: Use only reviewed shared owner helpers in phase 2. Include exact integer/float/bool types; 0, -0, 1, 1.0, 1e0, 01, 2^53, 2^53+1, 2^60, uint64 max and owner domain endpoints where applicable. A representation-route refusal is not a schema-domain limit. Timestamp positives/negatives use the actual owner profile (CV-253 persisted UTC Z versus general RFC3339), including permitted leap seconds/fractions and retained old profiles.
families.source_specific_rules: Validate original endpoint mutation receipt, before/after endpoint generations, parent Server and current Catalog/trust fences. First add proves absence; later changes advance the exact endpoint generation. Verified identity requires independently checked fingerprint continuity; mismatch creates a blocked non-preferred observation and cannot merge records, replace server_id or move a Project. Event metadata keeps address/configuration by protected non-secret reference rather than copying URLs or local paths.
phase_2_gates: Rebase on reviewed NUMRULE and GUARDTOOL foundation supplied by lead.
Implement oracle fixtures/checker with shared helpers, eagerly resolve every reference, inventory each real predicate/site.
Every negative has exactly one invariant defect and becomes passing only when that guard or its exact duplicate sites are cut.
Sol and Astra reviews follow; no phase-1 admission readiness claim.

schema_case_recipes.positive: Start with a fully valid instance of the selected payload/owner_fact/custody/history/checkpoint body or wrapper branch; all independent source, identity, digest and permission joins are owner-valid.
schema_case_recipes.type: For each pointer separately replace only the targeted value with a string, boolean, number, null, array and object outside its allowed exact type; treat bool separately from int. Do not claim isolation for a type predicate implied by another live predicate; inventory actual sites under the shared tool.
schema_case_recipes.const: Supply one same-type, structurally valid unequal value at the selected constant. Keep downstream non-target commitments coherent.
schema_case_recipes.enum: Supply one same-type value outside the selected enum; include positives for every allowed value under its own valid owner branch.
schema_case_recipes.required: Delete exactly required_property from the otherwise valid selected object; distinguish conditionally required branch cases.
schema_case_recipes.additionalProperties: Add exactly one unknown property to the selected closed object.
schema_case_recipes.minimum_maximum: Use the exact bound as positive and bound-minus-one or bound-plus-one as negative, preserving declared type and all other intervals.
schema_case_recipes.minLength_maxLength: Use an otherwise valid string at the exact length, then cross exactly one applicable bound; update non-target dependent commitments. For source-fixed strings, boundary coverage belongs to the lexical guard before source joining.
schema_case_recipes.not: For the no-control-character predicate insert exactly one prohibited control character; for other not clauses violate only their selected predicate. Trailing LF is a separate explicit case.
schema_case_recipes.pattern: Use one full-string mismatch that still meets type and length; include trailing LF. Do not treat the schema pattern as a runtime full-match proof.
schema_case_recipes.conditional_union: Each if/then/else and oneOf/anyOf route gets its own valid branch plus one invalid field/route at a time; never cut an entire keyword containing distinct predicates.
schema_case_recipes.reference: Resolve every local and external reference eagerly, recursively including owner_fact/checkpoint body. Break one unvisited reference in a copied package as the one-defect negative.
schema_case_recipes.isolation: Each negative targets one input invariant. Repair unrelated hashes/copies/key/post-state. Do not merge different predicates merely because one implies another or shares a keyword/refusal.
